# Healthie

> > Healthie is a comprehensive HIPAA-compliant EHR platform with integrated practice management, clinical tools, and patient engagement features designed for modern healthcare providers.

Healthie provides an all-in-one electronic health record system built for telehealth, private practices, and integrated care delivery. The platform combines clinical documentation, scheduling, billing, and patient engagement tools with AI-powered features and a robust partner ecosystem through Healthie Harbor.

## Key Topics

- HIPAA-compliant EHR
- Practice management
- Patient engagement
- Telehealth platform
- Clinical documentation
- AI Scribe
- Patient portal
- Insurance billing
- Workflow automation
- Healthie Harbor integrations
- Care plans
- Patient scheduling
- Secure messaging
- Analytics & reporting
- Cloud-based healthcare software

## Core Platform

- [Healthie | HIPAA Compliant Electronic Health Record Software](https://www.gethealthie.com): Healthie homepage: HIPAA-compliant EHR platform with practice management and patient engagement tools.
- [EHR Technology Platform for Healthcare | Healthie](https://www.gethealthie.com/platform-overview): Comprehensive overview of Healthie's EHR platform, practice management, and clinical tools.
- [The Harbor: Partner Apps & Integrations | Healthie](https://harbor.gethealthie.com): The Harbor: Healthie's ecosystem of partner integrations and third-party applications.

## Clinical Documentation & Care Management

- [AI Scribe Templates | Healthie](https://www.gethealthie.com/ai-scribe): Healthie's AI Scribe: automated clinical documentation and charting templates.
- [Client Charting Templates | Healthie](https://www.gethealthie.com/charting): AI-powered charting templates and clinical documentation tools for Healthie users.
- [Custom Health Care Plans for Patients | Healthie](https://www.gethealthie.com/care-plans): Personalized care plans with patient goals tracking and progress monitoring in Healthie.
- [Clinical Care Management & Tools Suite | Healthie](https://www.gethealthie.com/clinical-care-tools): Healthie's clinical tools: referrals, e-prescriptions, e-labs, and care management.

## Patient Engagement & Communication

- [Patient Engagement Solutions & Platform | Healthie](https://www.gethealthie.com/patient-portal): Healthie's patient portal for engagement, communication, and healthcare access.
- [HIPAA Compliant Messaging for Telehealth | Healthie](https://www.gethealthie.com/messaging): Healthie's HIPAA-compliant secure messaging for patient-provider communication.
- [Patient Journaling for Engagement & Care | Healthie](https://www.gethealthie.com/journaling): Healthie's patient journaling with wearable integration for wellness tracking.
- [Online Health & Nutrition Programs | Healthie](https://www.gethealthie.com/health-wellness-programs): Healthie's online health and nutrition program creation and management tools.
- [Healthie App: EHR & Care on the Go for Providers | Healthie](https://www.gethealthie.com/mobile-app): Healthie mobile app for provider and patient access to EHR and clinical tools.

## Practice Operations & Administration

- [Client Intake Forms | Healthie](https://www.gethealthie.com/intake-onboarding): Healthie's HIPAA-compliant client intake forms and automated patient onboarding.
